heading: MIC Digital Overcurrent Relay - Legacy

text: The MIC 1000 is a digital, microprocessor- based overcurrent relay that provides nondirectional phase to phase and phase to ground overcurrent protection. The relay's overcurrent function can be inverse time, where four families of curves are provided, or definite time with four times offered, as well instantaneous operation with adjustable time delay. All of these features are offered in a single relay.
